name: Chaos Breed
body:
School transmutation [chaotic]; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser chaos breed, except your blindsense is 10 feet, resistance to acid and electricity 10, and DR 10/law, and you gain the ability to float allowing you to fly at a speed of 30 feet with average maneuverability. In addition, your natural weapons and any weapons you wield are considered chaotically-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
